episodes.title: Boil, Bubble, a Witch in Trouble / Headless House Guest
episodes.summary: Bat Pat and the kids visit a witch's cottage in the Whispering Forest. A headless horseman frightens the residents of Fogville.

episodes.title: Survival of the Trolliest / Howl at the Moon
episodes.summary: A reality TV host finds a mysterious creature while filming on Black Skull Island. A pet shop owner asks Bat Pat and the team for help.

episodes.title: An Uncomfortable Situation / The Lady in the Mirror
episodes.summary: A famous Egyptian king's museum exhibit is missing its mummy. A ghost seems to be haunting the mirrors of Fogville.

episodes.title: Something's Fishy / Pirates Ahoy
episodes.summary: A strange water creature seen near the pier leads to rumors of a sea monster. Mr. Trotter claims to have seen a ghostly ship.

episodes.title: Wail of a Tale / Two Big Left Feet
episodes.summary: Bat Pat and the team investigate an eerie wail emanating from Dreary Swamp. A big hairy creature is spotted, then shows up to a school dance.

episodes.title: A Big Stink / Eye of the Beholder
episodes.summary: A smelly mystery beast uses the mayor's shower, then retreats to Dreary Swamp. Several shops are wrecked the night before Valentine's Day.

episodes.title: Love at First Fright / Such a Fright
episodes.summary: Martin's new teacher is nervous and thinks that she's being followed. Mr. Trotter sees a ghost while bird-watching and is afraid to return.

episodes.title: Thing Under the Bed / Monster Jam
episodes.summary: Bat Pat and the crew help a friend who's scared of a monster under the bed. A problem with school basketballs leads the team to the Whispering Forest.

episodes.title: Gnome Alone / How to Restrain Your Dragon
episodes.summary: Garden gnomes begin disappearing from the gardens of Fogville. Searching for a fiery pepper, Bat Pat and friends meet a magical guardian.

episodes.title: Over the Rainbow / Ocean's Roar
episodes.summary: Rainbows appear over the Whispering Forest, driving its creatures into Fogville. Sudden potholes in the roads block people from getting to the beach.

episodes.title: Frozen to the Bones / Puppy Love
episodes.summary: A shadowy, rattling figure disturbs Bat Pat and friends on a camping trip. Bat Pat and the kids adopt a cute stray puppy.

episodes.title: Tooth or Consequences / Two Heads Aren't Better
episodes.summary: A mysterious being enters the rooms of sleeping children who have lost a tooth. Bat Pat and the team hear of strange goings-on at the town junkyard.

episodes.title: Just My Luck / Please Don't Make a Wish
episodes.summary: Bat Pat's crew helps a leprechaun who has lost his pot of gold. The wishes of Fogville residents come true, but not exactly how they'd hoped.

episodes.title: Ghost of a Chance / Sealed with a Curse
episodes.summary: Martin is suspected of being a mysterious "ghost bike" rider. The gang discovers a creature in the library while making a float for the school fair.

episodes.title: Dream a Little Dream / Toothless Terror
episodes.summary: The people of Fogville start having bad dreams that aren't their own. A bat frightening Fogville leads to the town being declared a bat-free zone.

episodes.title: A Haunting Problem / Moonstruck
episodes.summary: A school janitor is frightened by a ghost and Rebecca wants to investigate. A hairy beast from the Whispering Forest is scaring Fogville.

episodes.title: Cookie Crumbles / Nothing to Laugh At
episodes.summary: Bat Pat and friends help Corky the Cookie Elf get a new cookie maker. The gang meets an unusual ghost during a school field trip to a castle.

episodes.title: Slip, Slide and Away / Romeo and Zombiet
episodes.summary: A melody coming from the sewers puts the citizens of Fogville into a trance. A strange creature frightens the star of the school play.

episodes.title: Unbearable / The Chosen Martin
episodes.summary: Bat Pat and friends try to find Martin, who is lost in the Whispering Forest. A Japanese ghost tries to train Martin in the martial arts.

episodes.title: Having a Ball / Queen of the Monkeys
episodes.summary: After a ghostly encounter in the library, the gang finds that Capistrano is missing. Missing tools lead to the theory of a tool vampire.

episodes.title: BFF: Bat Friends Forever / Roc of Ages
episodes.summary: A bat arrives at the Silver home claiming to be Bat Pat's cousin. The Bat Pat crew tries to identify a thief stealing items all over town.

episodes.title: Footloose / Just Desserts
episodes.summary: A large creature stomps through Fogville, leaving a stinky green mist behind. A visitor to the kids' new clubhouse begs for their help.

episodes.title: The Voodoo That You Do / Kitty Cat Caper
episodes.summary: Melissa and her friends are spooked by a creepy doll. Leo's new hamster has some unusual habits, like walking on its hind legs.

episodes.title: Scared Stiff / Be Your Elf
episodes.summary: Phil's collection of action figures seems to come to life. Leo meets an elf who's looking for a challenge that will help him level up.

episodes.title: What's Cooking / Blown Away
episodes.summary: A legendary monster scares Elisabeth and makes off with her blueberry pie. Melody finds a wolf-like creature lurking in her own backyard.

episodes.title: A Haunting Celebration / Seeing Double
episodes.summary: A pirate captain's ghost seeks his lost treasure every year on his birthday. Rebecca starts acting strangely, so her friends think she has a double.
